purpose: Game functions OpenSPM mods may hook (docs/HOOKS.md). Only entries with enabled=true become host targets in the native module (one rebuild when that changes); the rest are listed for review. expect is the first instruction word, checked at build and at boot.

hooks.name: spsndSFXOn
hooks.why: proof hook: every sound effect the game starts (thunk into __spsndSFXOn 0x80238C34)

hooks.name: marioSetCharacter
hooks.why: characters v2: asserts 0 <= id < 4; ids 4+ are OpenSPM's

hooks.name: _marioChangeCharacter
hooks.why: characters v2: stores the id (MarioWork+0x38), reloads the model (0x80121CE0) and applies characterProperties (0x801220C4); called only by marioSetCharacter and one other site

hooks.name: marioApplyCharacterProperties
hooks.why: characters v2: copies characterProperties[id] (0x803E8228, 20 bytes: hitbox width, height, walk, dash, +16) into MarioWork (+0x194/+0x19C width, +0x198/+0x1A0 height, +0x14C walk, +0x150 dash, +0x158); a post hook sets a character's own values. 13 callers

hooks.name: marioLoadCharacterModel
hooks.why: characters v2: loads the anim poses named 0x803E8148[id * 2 + variant] (p_wii_* / p_big_*) into MarioWork+0x24C and +0x250; a pre hook points a new id at its own model

hooks.name: marioGetCharacterWidth
hooks.why: characters v2: hitbox width of the current character (7 callers); float result, needs hooks v2 (fret). Measure call rate before enabling

hooks.name: marioGetCharacterHeight
hooks.why: characters v2: hitbox height of the current character (3 callers); float result, needs hooks v2 (fret)

hooks.name: marioFairyUse
hooks.why: Pixls v2: asserts 220 <= id < 232; added Pixls are OpenSPM's

hooks.name: pixlFollowerSetup
hooks.why: Pixls v2: the follower setup, replacing the 'no game Pixl selected' trick

hooks.name: marioChgMot
hooks.why: movement: every move change (81 callers): saves the old move (MarioWork+0x2E), stores the new one (+0x2C), runs the old move's exit function (0x803E8718[old].exit) and asks for the new move to run at once; a pre hook redirects a change (a character's own jump, float, spin dash)

hooks.name: marioMotionMain
hooks.why: movement: once a frame runs 0x803E8718[MarioWork+0x2C].main (and again after a change); a pre hook runs a character's own per-frame movement before the game's
